title: Realtime-Bench: Can Frontier Models Solve Real-time Interactive Problems?
abstract: arXiv:2610.22155v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-time interaction requires agents to perceive evolving environments and act under temporal constraints, yet existing evaluations of real-time streaming models focus on conversational quality and streaming perception, leaving effective action under strict temporal constraints untested. We introduce Realtime-Bench, a suite of carefully curated dynamic tasks where delayed actions directly affect success. Under Wall Clock, where environments advance according to actual inference latency, the best success rate reaches only 44% and the best Pass^3 is only 36%, demonstrating that real-time interaction remains challenging. translated_title: Realtime-Bench：前沿模型能解决实时交互问题吗？
translated_abstract: 实时交互要求智能体感知不断变化的环境并在时间约束下采取行动，然而现有的实时流式模型评估主要关注对话质量和流式感知，缺乏对严格时间约束下有效行动能力的测试。我们提出了Realtime-Bench，这是一套精心设计的动态任务基准，其中行动延迟会直接影响任务成败。在Wall Clock（真实时钟）模式下，环境根据实际推理延迟推进，最佳模型的成功率仅为44%，最佳Pass^3仅为36%，表明实时交互仍然极具挑战性。为了将服务延迟与模型本身的实时流式能力区分开，我们将Wall Clock与Paused Clock（暂停时钟）进行对比，后者消除了推理延迟的影响，作为理想化的参照；同时引入Token Clock（令牌时钟），根据生成的令牌数量推进模拟时间，从而独立于物理服务基础设施来测试模型的时间感知能力。
tldr: 提出Realtime-Bench基准，通过Wall Clock、Paused Clock和Token Clock三种时钟模式评估前沿模型在严格时间约束下的实时交互能力，结果显示最佳成功率仅44%，证明实时交互对现有模型仍是重大挑战。
